steps.en: Write a config file on each node: directories, shared rpc_secret, S3 bind address
steps.zh: 每台机器写一份配置：目录、共享 rpc_secret、S3 监听地址

steps.en: Start the daemon on each machine that should hold data
steps.zh: 在每台要存数据的机器上启动守护进程

steps.en: Nodes find each other over their rpc addresses and act as one cluster
steps.zh: 各节点通过 rpc 地址互相发现，组成同一个集群

steps.en: Assign every node a zone and capacity, then apply the layout
steps.zh: 给每个节点指定 zone 与容量，再应用布局
steps.code: garage layout assign · garage layout apply

steps.en: Places copies across zones and keeps serving when a node is unreachable
steps.zh: 把副本铺到不同 zone，某节点失联时照常服务

steps.en: Create a bucket and a key, then point any S3 client at :3900
steps.zh: 建桶、建密钥，任意 S3 客户端指向 :3900
steps.code: garage key create · garage bucket allow

value.en: Multi-site S3 storage from cheap, heterogeneous machines — you stop needing a datacenter or a heavyweight storage cluster
value.zh: 用便宜、异构的机器拼出跨站点 S3：不必有数据中心，也不必运维重型存储集群
